hero.title: Welcome to UMLপ্রাঙ্গণ
hero.description: UMLপ্রাঙ্গণ is the digital home of the Bangladeshi Students' Association at UMass Lowell, bringing together the people, events, resources, stories, and shared traditions that shape our community. Whether you are new to Lowell, already part of the association, or simply looking to stay connected, this is a place to find what matters across BSA UML.

people.name: Dr. Abu Hena Muhammad Nazir Hossain
people.title: From our Faculty Advisor
people.role: Adjunct Faculty, Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering
people.speech: The Bangladeshi Students Association at UMass Lowell plays an important role in bringing together students, celebrating our cultural heritage, and fostering a sense of belonging away from home. As Faculty Advisor, I am pleased to support an organization that promotes friendship, collaboration, and mutual support among our students. I encourage everyone to participate actively, share their experiences, and contribute to building a welcoming and vibrant community. I wish BSA continued success in all its endeavors.

people.name: Progga Paul
people.title: From our President
people.role: Graduate Research Assistant, Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences
people.speech: BSA is more than just a student association. It's a community away from home. Serving as a President of BSA is both an honor and responsibility. I look forward to working with all our members to strenthen our community and celebrate the culture and connections that bring us together.
